# Olfia Rachmi W

> AI & Computer Vision Engineer based in Bali, open to remote or hybrid roles. Builds computer vision models and the web apps that put them to work.

3+ years shipping React and Next.js apps, now working in machine learning: curates data, trains and tunes models, wraps them in apps people can use. Coding instructor since 2022 (Timedoor Academy); 98% of students finish their final project.

Skills: Python, PyTorch, YOLOv8, OpenCV, Roboflow, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Webflow, FastAPI, Node.js, Firebase, Realm, Google Maps API.

Experience: Coding Instructor, Timedoor (2022 - now, part-time); Web Specialist, Freelance (2026); Full-stack Developer, Semantu (2023 - 2025); Frontend Developer, Venatronics LLC (2022 - 2023); Coding Teacher, Kodland (2022 - 2023, part-time).
